caption: This is a black and white line drawing depicting a wrought and cast iron gate. The gate is composed of two ornate doors, each attached to a tall, decorated post. At the top of each post is a large, decorative urn-shaped finial. The gates themselves feature a combination of vertical bars, circular and spiral motifs, and curved ironwork forming an intricate design. Behind the gate are faint outlines of tall, leafy trees rendered in a simple, stylized manner. The drawing is labeled "WROUGHT and CAST IRON GATE" at the bottom, and includes some measurements on the right and below the gate, specifically 36 inches, 10 inches, 25 feet, 20 feet, and 7 feet, indicating the dimensions of different parts of the gate and surrounding area. The overall composition is balanced and symmetrical, with the foliage providing a background within a rectangular border. The image is entirely in black ink on a cream or off-white paper background.
title: Iron Gates
